استكينوا (form X)
# اُسْتُكِينُوا (ustukīnū) /us.tu.kiː.nuː/: third-person masculine plural past passive of اِسْتَكَانَ (istakāna)
# اِسْتَكِينُوا (istakīnū) /is.ta.kiː.nuː/: second-person masculine plural imperative of اِسْتَكَانَ (istakāna)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
